poll.source_locator: Q8 'There are 3 candidates for governor ... who you plan to vote for or lean toward': Amy Acton 48.00 (240), Don Kissick (L) 3.60 (18), Vivek Ramaswamy 44.00 (220), Vote/Lean Write-in 0.40, Undecided 3.20, Refused 0.80
poll.notes: other = Kissick 3.6 + write-in 0.4; refused 0.8 excluded. 'Plan to vote for or lean toward' wording (leaners folded into the single item); kept FULL to match the held Sept 23-27 Ohio wave. 17.2% already voted (Q1). Marginals header: 'SUPRC / USA TODAY NETWORK OHIO', 'Likely Ohio Voters 10/21 - 10/26'. MoE +/-4.4 per Wikipedia (not printed in marginals).

pollster.method_locator: Marginals contain the interviewer script and a recalled 2024 vote question (Q18) but no weighting statement; no methodology release found
